hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try $-1$ and $-2$ first, thinking of temperatures. Which is warmer? The warmer temperature is the greater number.
The symbol $>$ means "is greater than", and greater means farther right on a number line. Think about where the two numbers sit.
$-5$ is $5$ units left of $0$ and $-10$ is $10$ units left, so $-5$ is to the right of $-10$. Find the statement that says this.
The true statement is $-5 > -10$, which is choice B.

explanation: On a number line, the number farther right is the greater one.
$-5$ is closer to $0$ than $-10$ is, so $-5$ lies to the right of $-10$.
That means $-5$ is greater than $-10$, and the two numbers are certainly not equal.
The true statement is $-5 > -10$, which is choice B.
